title: Registered-family full Q3 character double-commutator bound
question: Can the registered kinetic character estimate and compact-source endpoint moment be combined with a global scalar edge-force inequality to bound the complete onsite-plus-edge Q3 force and the full local-character second commutator uniformly over the registered finite periodic compact-source family?

Derive the onsite cubic-force fourth envelope from k_x>=1+gamma*q_x^4 and the registered m5 bound, retaining q^12<=k_x^5/gamma^3.
Use the pair third-moment bridge and the z-neighbour fourth-power sum inequality to bound the complete onsite-plus-edge force fourth moment.
Combine the exact kinetic/force CCR split with the two-sided Hilbert-space triangle inequality, and use a deliberately loose rational square-root envelope for an exact reproducible coefficient.
Rebuild all rational arithmetic in an independent lane, check a reversed field grid as a sanity test, and compile Lean R322 for the exact fixtures.
finding: Primary 190/190, independent 187/187, integrated 33/33, and Lean R322 PASS. The global edge constant is 12/5; the pair third-moment bound is 35834571/64; the complete force fourth bound is 2282697884376432/5; the kinetic second-norm bound is 49153/65536; and the deliberately safe rational full second-norm bound is 18699861068811976709/163840.

This is a genuine QFT-facing static input, but it does not sum time histories or establish arbitrary-boundary/all-shape common dynamics.
